baselineSeparation: Earlier 95d7c05 baseline attempts and 2026-10-31 monitoring drills remain separate; their passes do not qualify this final candidate.

previousFailedSteady.interpretation: 567 native Security events were all forwarded and queued; 600 failed-authentication API calls are not 600 proven native events. This does not establish 33 losses inside WEC/Bower.

steady.qualificationScope: This phase identity reconciliation only; outage, recovery and cleanup require separate evidence.
steady.queryText:
BowerSecurity_CL
| where CollectorId == "bower-ws6-20261101-011000-windows" and ApplicationName == "windows-security"
    and ApplicationEnvironment == "production" and EventType == "authentication_failure"
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-01T02:56:04.589545+00:00) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-11-01T02:57:09.609150+00:00)
| where ingestion_time() <= datetime(2026-11-01T03:00:04.160035+00:00)
| summarize Copies=count(), FirstGenerated=min(TimeGenerated), LastGenerated=max(TimeGenerated),
    FirstIngested=min(ingestion_time()), LastIngested=max(ingestion_time()) by EventId
| project EventId, Copies, FirstGenerated, LastGenerated, FirstIngested, LastIngested
| take 200001

previousFailedBurst.interpretation: 6000 calls produced only 3179 observed native events; all 3179 were forwarded and queued. This is a failed native-generation qualification, not proof of 2821 WEC/Bower losses.

windowsOriginalFailedSmoke.cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 disk binding failed before the UInt64 fix.
windowsOriginalFailedSmoke.interpretation: This is a real failed sampler run, distinct from the later fixed run and its premature export attempt.

limitations: Firewall pass covers exact identity reconciliation for the listed steady/burst scenarios, not one-hour outage or general production readiness.
Sampler completeness is resource evidence only and does not establish destination delivery.
The original Windows smoke failed all five metric samples under PS5.1 and is preserved. The fixed run passed all five. A separate premature export of the fixed run is recorded independently.
